title: Deep learning searches for technosignatures around 820 nearby stars
summary: A deep-learning method analyzed 150 TB of Green Bank Telescope data from 820 stars, previously searched in 2017 without interesting signals, and found eight narrowband signals of interest with nonzero drift, present only in observations where the target was in view. Follow-up observations did not find them again; no claim of extraterrestrial origin.
organization: SETI Institute; Breakthrough Listen and University of Toronto

evidence.tested: The deep-learning method analyzed Green Bank Telescope data from 820 stars and flagged eight narrowband candidates; the page reports no follow-up results and no injection tests, and the abstract gives no false-positive figures.
evidence.unknown: The page states no limitations; rejecting human radio interference is named as the core challenge, and the full paper's methods, which the listing says were later published in Nature Astronomy, were not read.
evidence.ai_role: A beta-Convolutional Variational Autoencoder flagged technosignature candidates in a semi-unsupervised manner.
